alert_news.title: India’s First Dedicated AI School – Benjamin Gupta School of Physical AI at IIT Kharagpur
bullets: India’s first dedicated AI school, the Benjamin Gupta School of Physical AI, established at IIT Kharagpur through a tripartite MoU with Vinod Gupta and the IIT Kharagpur Foundation.
Total funding of Rs 35 crore, comprising Rs 12.5 crore from the Vinod Gupta family, Rs 10 crore from another alumnus, and the remaining amount from IIT Kharagpur.

alert_news.title: 4 launch pads by 2029! ISRO reveals a massive space plan with a Gaganyaan surprise
bullets: ISRO’s first uncrewed Gaganyaan test, a milestone toward India’s first human spaceflight mission
Plan to establish four launch pads by 2029, including a 2,000‑acre spaceport at Kulasekarapattinam, Tamil Nadu

alert_news.title: Mumbai-Ahmedabad Bullet Train Gets 2027 Launch Target, Undersea Tunnel Takes Shape
bullets: India’s first undersea rail tunnel beneath Thane Creek, part of the Mumbai‑Ahmedabad high‑speed rail corridor
508‑km corridor with 12 stations, trains to run at 320 km/h

alert_news.title: Ladakh Becomes India's First Fully Organic Union Territory
bullets: Ladakh declared India's first 100% organic Union Territory, covering Leh and Kargil districts
207 villages certified as organic by July 2026, with prohibition of synthetic fertilizers and pesticides

alert_news.title: India's First Autonomous Maritime Shipyard Launched in Nellore
bullets: India’s first autonomous maritime shipyard and systems development centre, located at Juvvaladinne Fishing Harbour in Nellore district, Andhra Pradesh, developed by Sagar Defence Engineering
First phase investment of ₹45 crore, 29.58 acres of land (7.58 acres waterfront), with commercial operations slated for November 2026
